title: State vector
description: Three 0-3 scores (funding, programme, pathway) plus the rubric version they were assigned under. Not to be confused with the run's continuation state vector (continuation_state_vector.schema.json).

funding.description: Funding axis score. Financial fit against the run's funded_definition. Integer 0-3, or the string '?' when evidence is insufficient. '?' means MISSING DATA, never zero.

programme.description: Programme axis score. Curriculum fit against the knowledge domains of the Study & Pathway Map. Integer 0-3, or the string '?' when evidence is insufficient. '?' means MISSING DATA, never zero.

pathway.description: Pathway axis score. Fit of the people, partners, placements or schemes connected to the programme against the pathway signals of the Study & Pathway Map, and whether students of THIS programme can reach them. Integer 0-3, or the string '?' when evidence is insufficient. '?' means MISSING DATA, never zero.

rubric_version.description: Version of the rubric/anchors used to assign these scores (e.g. '1.0'). Lets a later run tell methodology change from real change.

notes.description: Free-text justification per axis. If an override changes a score, the override record (not this text) is the source of truth.
